tracker.confidencePolicy: Keep tracker confidence in quality metadata; do not use continuous confidence as a recognition feature.

coordinates.mirrorPolicy: Apply one explicit source adapter before canonical dominance. PopSign uses keep based on the Nov 9 cross-source audit.
coordinates.depthPolicy: Keep local hand z. Center visible shoulder-normalized wrist z on its active-interval median so only relative toward/away movement remains.

dominanceNormalization.selection: The detected hand present in the most active-interval frames is dominant; ties keep the right hand as dominant.
dominanceNormalization.leftDominantRule: Reflect x coordinates, exchange paired upper-body anchors, and place the detected left hand in the dominant slot.

shapeNormalization.scale: mean 2D distance from wrist to index MCP, middle MCP, and pinky MCP
shapeNormalization.rotation: none; preserve palm and finger orientation
shapeNormalization.reason: A 2D palm scale is comparable across tracker versions while local z still preserves relative hand depth.

normalization.missingRule: Coordinates are zero only with present zero. Continuous visibility is quality metadata, not model input.

excluded: hips because availability differed from 100% in Google-adapted data to under 1% in PopSign
body z because tracker-version offsets were not source comparable

sequence.raw: Retain increasing timestamps or source-frame indexes and every stable detailed hand result before normalization.

activeInterval.rule: Form dominant-hand candidate runs by bridging at most three missing source frames. Prefer the run with the strongest combination of observed detections and detection density; use wrist motion only to break otherwise similar candidates. Retain two source frames of preparation/ending context on each side.
activeInterval.browserRule: A hands-free countdown begins capture after readiness so reaching for a control is outside the captured interval.
activeInterval.offlineCaveat: Automatic trimming cannot always distinguish a tracked reach, false detection, or preparation from the sign. Ambiguous extracted intervals remain review failures, but a failed interval does not automatically invalidate its source clip.

sequence.selectionRule: The Developer provisionally approved 48 after it was the smallest candidate to pass both the initial v1-reference check and the post-trim v2 active-interval check on Google and PopSign. Active-interval visual review remains required before training.
sequence.resampling: Nearest observed source frame by timestamp or source-frame index across the active interval; do not interpolate across missing detections.
sequence.missingValues: Use zero coordinates only together with an explicit zero presence value.
sequence.frameFeatureLayout: dominant hand 67, non-dominant hand 67, then 11 upper-body anchors x 3

requirements.handChannels: Required for every supported sign and retained at full raw capture cadence.
requirements.bodyChannels: Required only when catalog metadata says body-relative location is discriminative.
requirements.faceExpressionChannels: Not included in v2; expression-dependent signs remain unsupported.
requirements.deviceModes: Standard and Reduced modes may change body update cadence but never hand landmark count.
